continuity.campaign_development: August 58 BCE: Valerius returns to Rome's political centers, makes himself available to anyone who requests him regardless of rank, and distributes copies of his own scholarly writings as gifts while presenting courtesy and generosity as practices of virtue.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 sq mi; Round 42 adds 0.25; Round 55 measures the earlier former-bandit aggregate; Round 59 adds 0.50 to reach 7.5625; Round 65 adds 0.125 sq mi to reach 7.6875. Round 67 adds no land.

special_event_policy.rule: Special is a core event category. Every round performs one independent random Special-event roll using the base probability. Success adds one Special event to the ordinary round event set; failure adds none. There is no candidate-selection, raw-success, or accepted-candidate stage.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_policy: tracked separately only when required; it is not part of Special-event selection.
